description: Perform binomial hypothesis tests for population proportions.

concepts.def: X ~ B(n,p): n trials, success probability p, count successes.
H₀: p = p₀ vs H₁: p ≠ p₀ (or one-tailed).
Use X directly under H₀; find tail probabilities.
Smallest X with P(X ≥ x) ≤ α (upper-tail).
If observed X is in critical region, reject H₀.
For large n use normal approximation N(np, np(1−p)).
